0022600135.text: The Pacers host the Philadelphia 76ers in their fifth game of the 2026-27 season, with Indiana at 2-2, third in the Central and one game back, and 8th in the East after a loss, going 0-1 at home and 2-1 on the road. Philadelphia comes in at 3-1, second in the Atlantic and 4th in the East, also on a one-game losing streak, with a 2-1 home record and a 1-0 road record. The teams have not met yet this season, but Indiana lost the 2025-26 series 0-4, most recently 105-94 in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Ben Sheppard (knee), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain).
